name: ChatterMate
description: AI customer-support agent with a website chat widget, knowledge-base answers and handoff to human agents.
whatItDoes: Answers customer questions around the clock from a company's own content and passes conversations to staff when it cannot help. It integrates with tools such as Shopify, Slack and Jira for support teams.
howItWorks: A Python backend runs the agent against an indexed knowledge base and tracks conversations, while a web dashboard manages agents and human takeover. Self-hosting is handled by a deploy tool that generates and starts a Docker project. A separate CLI is also published.

requirements.name: Docker and Node.js
requirements.description: The deploy tool is an npm package that starts containers

requirements.name: LLM provider key
requirements.description: Key for the selected model provider

models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, xAI, DeepSeek, Groq
